Grow. function toggleSidebar() { const sidebar = document.getElementById('crmSidebar'); const overlay = document.getElementById('crmSidebarOverlay'); sidebar.classList.toggle('open'); overlay.classList.toggle('active'); document.body.classList.toggle('sidebar-open', sidebar.classList.contains('open')); } function toggleSubmenu(id) { const item = document.getElementById(id); if (item) { item.classList.toggle('open'); } } function toggleDropdown(dropdownId) { const dropdown = document.getElementById(dropdownId); const allDropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.crm-dropdown-menu'); allDropdowns.forEach(d => { if (d.id !== dropdownId) d.classList.remove('open'); }); if (dropdown) { dropdown.classList.toggle('open'); } } const selectedCompanies = new Set(['Ultrawin Technolgies']); function toggleCompanySelection(name, elem) { const checkbox = elem.querySelector('.crm-company-checkbox'); const checkIcon = elem.querySelector('.crm-company-checkbox i'); if (selectedCompanies.has(name)) { // Prevent unselecting if it's the only one selected if (selectedCompanies.size > 1) { selectedCompanies.delete(name); elem.classList.remove('selected'); if (checkbox) checkbox.classList.remove('selected'); if (checkIcon) checkIcon.style.display = 'none'; } } else { selectedCompanies.add(name); elem.classList.add('selected'); if (checkbox) checkbox.classList.add('selected'); if (checkIcon) checkIcon.style.display = 'block'; } // Update topbar label and footer dynamically const count = selectedCompanies.size; const labelElem = document.getElementById('currentCompanyName'); const badgeElem = document.getElementById('selectedCountBadge'); const footerElem = document.getElementById('crmDashboardFooter'); if (count === 1) { const singleName = Array.from(selectedCompanies)[0]; labelElem.innerText = singleName; if (footerElem) footerElem.innerHTML = `${singleName} CRM · Connect. Manage. Grow.`; } else { labelElem.innerText = count + ' Companies'; if (footerElem) footerElem.innerHTML = `Ultrawin Technolgies CRM · Connect. Manage. Grow.`; } if (badgeElem) { badgeElem.innerText = count + ' Selected'; } } function markAllRead() { document.querySelectorAll('.crm-notif-item').forEach(item => { item.classList.remove('unread'); }); const dot = document.getElementById('crmNotifDot'); if (dot) dot.style.display = 'none'; const badge = document.querySelector('.crm-notif-head span'); if (badge) badge.innerText = '0 Unread'; } // Close dropdowns when clicking outside document.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (!e.target.closest('.crm-dropdown-container')) { document.querySelectorAll('.crm-dropdown-menu').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('open')); } }); // --- INTERACTIVE SALES BAR CHART (FRONTEND-ONLY) --- const salesDataPresets = { 3: [ { label: 'Jul', total: 52000, days: 31, color: '#38bdf8' }, { label: 'Aug', total: 84000, days: 31, color: '#0284c7' }, { label: 'Sep', total: 92600, days: 30, color: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #38bdf8 0%, #0284c7 100%)' } ], 6: [ { label: 'Apr', total: 24000, days: 30 }, { label: 'May', total: 35000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Jun', total: 55000, days: 30 }, { label: 'Jul', total: 40000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Aug', total: 80000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Sep', total: 92600, days: 30, color: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #38bdf8 0%, #0284c7 100%)' } ], 12: [ { label: 'Oct', total: 18000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Nov', total: 22000, days: 30 }, { label: 'Dec', total: 31000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Jan', total: 28000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Feb', total: 36000, days: 28 }, { label: 'Mar', total: 42000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Apr', total: 39000, days: 30 }, { label: 'May', total: 45000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Jun', total: 58000, days: 30 }, { label: 'Jul', total: 64000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Aug', total: 82000, days: 31 }, { label: 'Sep', total: 92600, days: 30, color: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #38bdf8 0%, #0284c7 100%)' } ] }; function renderSalesBars(months) { const container = document.getElementById('crmSalesBarChart'); const tooltip = document.getElementById('crmBarTooltip'); if (!container) return; // Clear existing bars but preserve tooltip container.querySelectorAll('.crm-bar-col').forEach(col => col.remove()); const maxVal = Math.max(...months.map(m => m.total)); months.forEach(m => { const heightPct = Math.round((m.total / maxVal) * 90); const col = document.createElement('div'); col.className = 'crm-bar-col'; col.innerHTML = ` ₹ ${(m.total / 1000).toFixed(1)}K
${m.label} `; const pill = col.querySelector('.crm-bar-pill'); const valLbl = col.querySelector('.crm-bar-val-lbl'); // Click bar: filter alert col.addEventListener('click', () => { alert(`Filter Won Deals for: ${m.label} 2026 (Total: ₹ ${(m.total / 1000).toFixed(1)}K)`); }); // Interactive Scrubber attached to whole column (easy to drag down to Day 1) function updateScrub(e) { // Hide the static number so client only sees the single tooltip value if (valLbl) valLbl.style.opacity = '0'; // Disable transition during drag for instant responsiveness pill.style.transition = 'none'; const rect = col.getBoundingClientRect(); const trackHeight = Math.max(80, rect.height - 35); const relY = Math.max(0, Math.min(trackHeight, rect.bottom - 22 - e.clientY)); const ratio = Math.max(0.03, Math.min(1, relY / trackHeight)); const currentDay = Math.min(m.days, Math.max(1, Math.round(ratio * m.days))); const currentVal = Math.round(ratio * m.total); pill.style.height = (ratio * heightPct) + '%'; tooltip.style.display = 'flex'; tooltip.style.left = (col.offsetLeft + (col.offsetWidth / 2)) + 'px'; tooltip.style.top = (rect.bottom - relY - 26) + 'px'; document.getElementById('crmTooltipDate').innerText = `${m.label} · Day ${currentDay}/${m.days}`; document.getElementById('crmTooltipVal').innerText = `₹ ${(currentVal / 1000).toFixed(1)}K`; } col.addEventListener('mousemove', updateScrub); col.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { // Elegant slow-speed recovery (0.7s smooth fluid bounce) pill.style.transition = 'height 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)'; pill.style.height = heightPct + '%'; tooltip.style.display = 'none'; // Restore static number smoothly if (valLbl) valLbl.style.opacity = '1'; }); container.appendChild(col); }); } function changeSalesRange(count, btn) { document.querySelectorAll('#crmSalesRangePills .crm-range-pill').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); if (btn) btn.classList.add('active'); renderSalesBars(salesDataPresets[count] || salesDataPresets[6]); } function toggleCustomRangeModal() { const rangePrompt = prompt("Enter custom month range (1 - 12):", "4"); if (rangePrompt) { const n = parseInt(rangePrompt); if (n >= 1 && n <= 12) { renderSalesBars(salesDataPresets[12].slice(-n)); } } } // Initial render on page load renderSalesBars(salesDataPresets[6]);
